notes.zh: 支持在 M-Pesa 代理点存现金的短信（Give Ksh… cash to …）：存款记进收入，标注「现金存款」，不播报。
notes.en: Cash you deposit at an M-Pesa agent ("Give Ksh… cash to …") is now recorded as money in, marked Cash deposit, and never announced.
notes.sw: Pesa unazoweka kwa wakala wa M-Pesa ("Give Ksh… cash to …") sasa zinaandikwa kwenye mapato zikiwa na lebo ya Kuweka pesa, na hazitangazwi.
